name: dobe_stalk_base
desc: Seen from behind. Remove the puddle at the bottom completely: below the waist the body narrows into one thick vertical stalk of glossy pink paint goo with yellow streaks that continues straight down and runs off the bottom edge of the picture, like the monster is growing out of a goo column. Sticky drips run down the stalk. Keep the head, ears, broad back, shoulders, arms, colors, marble, outline and pixel art style the same. Transparent background.
